title: Fake Bank Alert
scenario_text: You receive an SMS saying your bank account will be blocked unless you verify your details using a link.
options: Open the official banking app and verify the message
correct_answer: Open the official banking app and verify the message
explanation: Unexpected messages asking for account verification through links can be phishing attempts.
defence_tip: Never use links from suspicious SMS messages to access banking services.

title: Fake Delivery Message
scenario_text: An SMS claims that your package cannot be delivered because your address is incomplete and asks you to click a link.
options: Track the package using the official delivery website
correct_answer: Track the package using the official delivery website
explanation: Attackers often use fake delivery messages to trick users into visiting malicious websites.
defence_tip: Verify delivery information through the courier's official website or application.

title: Fake Reward Message
scenario_text: You receive an SMS claiming that you have won a large reward and must pay a small processing fee through a link.
options: Ignore the message and verify independently
correct_answer: Ignore the message and verify independently
explanation: Unexpected prize messages requesting money or personal information are common scam indicators.
defence_tip: Do not pay fees or provide financial information for unexpected rewards.

title: Fake SIM Verification
scenario_text: An SMS says your SIM card will be deactivated today unless you complete KYC verification through a provided link.
options: Click the link and upload documents
Call the number in the message
Contact the telecom provider through its official channel
correct_answer: Contact the telecom provider through its official channel
explanation: Attackers may impersonate telecom providers to collect identity information and OTPs.
defence_tip: Use official telecom apps, websites, or customer-care numbers for verification.

title: Fake OTP Request
scenario_text: You receive a message saying that a failed transaction occurred and asks you to share the OTP with a support representative.
options: Do not share the OTP and contact the official service
correct_answer: Do not share the OTP and contact the official service
explanation: OTP codes are authentication secrets and should never be shared with another person.
defence_tip: Never disclose OTPs, PINs, or passwords to anyone.

title: Fake Banking App
scenario_text: You find a banking app with the same logo and name as your bank, but it is published by an unknown developer. It asks for your login credentials immediately after installation.
options: Install it because the logo looks genuine
Enter your banking username and password
Check the official bank website or app store listing before installing
correct_answer: Check the official bank website or app store listing before installing
explanation: A familiar logo does not prove that an application is genuine. The developer and official listing should be verified.
defence_tip: Install sensitive apps only from trusted official sources.

title: Fake System Update
scenario_text: A browser pop-up says your phone security is outdated and asks you to install an APK file to update the system.
options: Check for updates through the phone's official settings
correct_answer: Check for updates through the phone's official settings
explanation: Unexpected APK downloads from browser pop-ups can be unsafe.
defence_tip: Use the phone's built-in update mechanism.

title: Duplicate Social Media App
scenario_text: You find a popular social media app with an almost identical name and icon, but it has very few downloads and an unfamiliar developer.
options: Install it because the icon looks genuine
Check the developer and official app listing
Enter your password to test it
correct_answer: Check the developer and official app listing
explanation: Attackers can create applications that imitate popular applications.
defence_tip: Verify the developer, reviews, downloads, and official listing before installation.

title: Suspicious QR Payment App
scenario_text: A QR code directs you to download a payment application from a website outside the official app store. The app requests SMS, contacts, microphone, and accessibility permissions.
options: Install it because it is a payment app
Avoid it and use a verified payment application
correct_answer: Avoid it and use a verified payment application
explanation: Unofficial payment applications requesting broad permissions can create serious security risks.
defence_tip: Use trusted payment applications from official sources and review permissions.

title: Fake Security Scanner
scenario_text: An app claims that your phone has multiple critical infections and asks for accessibility access so it can remove the threats automatically.
options: Uninstall the suspicious app and use a trusted security solution
correct_answer: Uninstall the suspicious app and use a trusted security solution
explanation: Fear-based warnings and requests for powerful permissions can indicate a malicious or deceptive application.
defence_tip: Do not grant powerful permissions to unknown applications.
